headline: Resolution 21-NQ/TW: Creating new momentum to develop a healthy and sustainable real estate market
summary: Resolution 21-NQ/TW sets out tasks and solutions to develop a healthy, safe and sustainable real estate market. It also aims to ensure residents' right to lawful housing and provide housing welfare.
why: Real estate policy shapes housing supply, developer activity and credit exposure in the property sector.
